article.story: ABILENE, Texas -- — Timeo Pons’ 30 points led Abilene Christian past McMurry 103-41 on Wednesday. Pons also contributed eight rebounds for the Wildcats (2-3). Drew Haffner scored 14 points, shooting 5 for 5, including 4 for 4 from beyond the arc. Xabi Lopez shot 4 of 7 from the field and 2 for 3 from the line to finish with 10 points. Koye Rondeno led the way for the War Hawks with seven points. Jordan Malveaux added seven points for McMurry. Up next Abilene Christian hosts Southwestern Adventist in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
